name: Business Days Calculator
summary: Count weekdays between dates or add business days — with holidays, locally.
description: Calculate business days between two dates (inclusive or exclusive) or add/subtract N business days from a start date. Weekends (Sat/Sun) are skipped; add optional holiday dates. All math runs in your browser.

faqs.question: What counts as a business day?
faqs.answer: Monday–Friday, excluding any dates you list as holidays. Saturday and Sunday are skipped.

faqs.question: Inclusive vs exclusive?
faqs.answer: Inclusive counts the start and end dates when they are business days (Excel NETWORKDAYS-style). Exclusive counts days after the start through the end.

faqs.question: Does adding N days include the start date?
faqs.answer: No. Adding 1 business day from a Friday lands on the following Monday (or the next non-holiday weekday).

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
